# set

> Immutably set a value at a path in a document using structural sharing.

<!-- Section to include introductory text. Make sure to keep an empty line after the intro `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="intro">

This function immutably sets a value at a specified path in a document. Only objects and arrays along the path are shallow-cloned; all other subtrees retain their original references (structural sharing).

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<!-- Package usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var set = require( '@stdlib/utils/json-patch/base/set' );
```

#### set( document, tokens, value )

Immutably sets a value at a path in a document using structural sharing.

```javascript
var doc = {
    'a': {
        'b': {
            'c': 1
        }
    }
};
var out = set( doc, [ 'a', 'b', 'c' ], 99 );
// returns { 'a': { 'b': { 'c': 99 } } }

var bool = ( doc.a.b === out.a.b );
// returns false

bool = ( doc === out );
// returns false
```

If `tokens` is an empty array (root pointer), the function returns `value` directly (root replacement).

```javascript
var doc = {
    'x': 1
};
var out = set( doc, [], [ 1, 2 ] );
// returns [ 1, 2 ]
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<!-- Package usage notes. Make sure to keep an empty line after the `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   Only objects and arrays along the path are shallow-cloned. All other subtrees keep their original references (structural sharing).
-   If `tokens` is empty (root pointer), returns `value` directly (root replacement).
-   The function throws an `Error` if any token is an unsafe value (e.g., `__proto__`, `constructor`).
-   The function throws a `TypeError` if an intermediate path segment references a non-traversable value (e.g., a string or number).

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<!-- Package usage examples. -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var set = require( '@stdlib/utils/json-patch/base/set' );

// Set a value at a shallow path:
var doc = {
    'a': 1,
    'b': 2
};
var out = set( doc, [ 'a' ], 99 );
console.log( out );
/* =>
    {
        'a': 99,
        'b': 2
    }
*/

// Set a value at a deep path:
doc = {
    'a': {
        'b': {
            'c': 1
        }
    }
};
out = set( doc, [ 'a', 'b', 'c' ], 42 );
console.log( out );
/* =>
    {
        'a': {
            'b': {
                'c': 42
            }
        }
    }
*/

// Root replacement (empty tokens):
doc = {
    'x': 1
};
out = set( doc, [], [ 42 ] );
console.log( out );
// => [ 42 ]

// Structural sharing (unchanged subtrees keep references):
doc = {
    'a': {
        'b': 1
    },
    'c': {
        'd': 2
    }
};
out = set( doc, [ 'a', 'b' ], 99 );
console.log( out.c === doc.c );
// => true
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->
